summary: Agent edited PAGE_SIZE 10→25 in list.js directly, with no brainstorming skill, no clarifying question, and no permission request.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria are satisfied per screen output, on-disk file contents, and session-log tool-call inspection.

observations.description: Minor: agent ran an `ls` and a repo-wide `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE` before reading list.js; harmless but slightly more search than the one-file request needed.
Startup required four separate confirmation dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) before any prompt could be entered.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ... 1 -const PAGE_SIZE = 10; 1 +const PAGE_SIZE = 25;" and "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. Nothing else changed." Disk check: `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE .` in coding-agent-workdir → "./list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". Tool sequence from session log: Bash(ls), Bash(grep PAGE_SIZE), Read, Edit.

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL listing all tool_use names returned only Bash, Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill/Task call. `grep -o '.{80}brainstorm.{80}'` on the log matched only system-prompt ladder text ("The Ladder: brainstorming or not"), not any invocation. Screen shows a single assistant reply reporting the completed edit, with no question or warning.
